title: Laptop connector private profile (0042 R2)
description: Private per-user storage, never a support export. No API key or pairing code. Completion/removal writes compare the authenticated session's seed. Unknown future fields are additive.

relay.description: Canonical relay host, optional port; no scheme, userinfo, path, query or fragment

seed.description: PRIVATE Ed25519 signing seed, owner-only; absent after authenticated removal

protectedSeed.description: Windows DPAPI CurrentUser ciphertext in canonical base64url; replaces seed on disk

port.description: Only an actually bound port is saved

connected.description: R4 remembered connect state; --always sets it, --disconnect/removal clears it
